name: test_commutator.py
mathematical_scope: Tests stationary Green commutator ranks and numerical spectral-error floors.
input_and_guard_coverage: Only fixed fields/parameters and n=8,16,32,64; does not cover arbitrary path permutations, nonstationary coefficients, singular matrices or invalid dimensions.
costs: Exact dense rank and numeric spectral norm costs inherited; not a circuit complexity measurement.
test_evidence: Seven methods test selected single/product rank upper bounds, Fourier full rank, and stable/near-resonant floor inequalities.
acceptance_boundary: Restricted stationary examples and bounds only; finite cases do not prove arbitrary Green-product exclusion.
findings: L11–21 consume audit result dictionaries; source identity and general hypotheses remain dependency obligations.
